long_biography.plain_text:
A discovery flight bought by his wife turned SAGE president David Natinsky from a software executive into a pilot and aviation-business co-owner. After training in Cirrus aircraft and building time on larger jets, he and a flight-school sales director established Stature Aviation to address a gap in Dallas-area training.

Stature began as a Cirrus training centre and expanded into aircraft management, brokerage and maintenance. Natinsky’s technical interest also led him to make a new business jet available as the certification aircraft for SmartSky’s Model 525 connectivity system. His participation gave the supplier a working test platform and an experienced owner-pilot able to assess the system in regular flight.

No current cap table reconfirms David's percentage, and no valuation ranks SAGE against his separate Stature Aviation interest.
